label: early original-phase inputs of 1/y/2/d/c/0 (first occurrence), context-gated
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.7% of mass), when the input token is one of 1, y, 2, d, c, 0 (about 89% of mass), usually on its first occurrence, and mostly at early positions (t<=4 holds about 82% of mass). It does not fire at the delimiter or during copy (roughly 60 activations total), and rarely on other input tokens (the most common are r, s, t). Magnitude depends on the prefix: the largest activations come at t=1-4 in sequences that start with l or e, or after preceding tokens like y, r, s, j. Input 1 at t=0 always fires but only weakly (about 0.02 of max). Precision is low (about 0.09): these tokens are inactive most of the time, and the prefix dependence could not be captured by simple conditions (the best prefix-gated variants reach F1 of only about 0.3).
